info.title: StatLine API
info.description:
StatLine v4 exposes adapters, packaged datasets, and one scoring pipeline.

## Two-step dataset scoring

1. Read CSV data as JSON with `GET /v4/datasets/{dataset}`.
2. Send the returned `rows` to `POST /v4/score` with an adapter.

For server-side convenience, `POST /v4/score` can also receive the packaged
`dataset` path directly. The scorer accepts exactly one of `row`, `rows`, or
`dataset`; raw mapping and PRI calculation are internal stages rather than
separate endpoints.

get.description: Returns every canonical adapter once plus process-cache diagnostics.
Replaces the former weights, metric-keys, inputs, dimensions, filters, traits, and spec endpoints with one document.
Lists CSV resources and the adapters that declare each dataset.
Returns a safe, paginated JSON view of a packaged CSV. Use the returned rows as the `rows` value in POST /v4/score for the documented two-step flow.

post.summary: Score a row, batch, or dataset
post.description: The v4 scoring pipeline replaces /map, /calc/pri, /pri, /score/row, and /score/batch. Supply exactly one of `row`, `rows`, or `dataset`. Raw input is mapped internally; set `input_kind` to `mapped` only when sending adapter metrics. Set `response_format` to `compact` to hoist exactly equal diagnostic metadata into `shared`; merge shared then row fields to reconstruct legacy values. Every result includes its original `source_index`; `source_id` is the adapter identity field when present. `output.show_explanation` enables optional raw-sum attribution.

post.summary: Evaluate a registered native pairwise model
post.description: Submit new-match rows (a) and previous rating rows (b) to an adapter-authored formula model. No supplied Python is executed.

PairwiseIn.title: PairwiseIn
PairwiseIn.description: Evaluate one registered native pairwise adapter using caller-provided rows.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Adapter ID, file stem, or declared alias.

input_kind.title: Input Kind
input_kind.description: Raw rows are mapped before scoring; mapped rows skip adapter mapping.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Weight profile name or bucket-to-weight override.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Score profiles to calculate. Omit or use 'all' for every profile.

caps_mode.title: Caps Mode
caps_mode.description: Use shared batch context or score each row independently.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Opt in to compact shared metadata. Legacy keeps row-level diagnostics; scored values are identical.

include_mapped.title: Include Mapped
include_mapped.description: Include the mapped rows used by the scorer in the response.

dataset_limit.title: Dataset Limit
dataset_limit.description: Optional safety limit when scoring a packaged dataset.

ScoreIn.title: ScoreIn
ScoreIn.description: One v4 request shape for a row, a batch, or a packaged dataset.

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: Exactly equal context_used, weights and explanation_context, only in compact mode. Row values override shared fields.

results.title: Results
results.description: One row per surviving input, with original source_index and source_id when available.

source_index.title: Source Index
source_index.description: Original input position before filtering; stable when clients sort results.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Adapter identity value when present. Duplicate names are allowed; use source_index for reconciliation.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Opt-in raw metric attribution with per-profile aggregates and score transforms.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: CSV or object field names used to identify compatible adapters.
